info.title: DummyJSON public read-only API
info.description: Reviewed against the pinned DummyJSON source. Record fields are dataset-inferred and optional because `select` and future dataset revisions can change their presence; no dataset values are embedded. HTTP errors are handled by the client layer.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum returned records; `0` requests all remaining records. Defaults to 30.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of matching records to skip. Defaults to 0.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Record field used to sort the list.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort direction when `sortBy` is supplied.

parameters.name: select
parameters.description: Comma-separated field names. Selected responses may omit other fields; `id` is retained.
